summary_1line: Bhishma recounts legends explaining how the Kshatriya race was restored and narrates the cursed birth and troubled life of the blind sage Dirghatamas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Parashurama stands on a battlefield with his axe raised after defeating the thousand‑armed Haihaya king Arjuna, surrounded by fallen warriors.
The unborn child in Mamata’s womb speaks while blocking the path of Vrihaspati’s seed, leading to the curse that will make him blind.
Pradweshi angrily orders her sons to throw the blind sage Dirghatamas into the waters of the Ganga.
